method: Three explicitly selected verbatim paragraphs from current Raveldex documentation; copied into shared fixture data before build. No runtime discovery, crawler or parser. Technical self-documentation fixture, not a representative relevance study.

selections.body: The only top-level keys are `id`, `text`, and `metadata`. `text` is required and may be empty; `metadata` is optional. Reject unknown field names. A declared text field may be missing, a string, or an array of strings. `null`, `undefined`, mixed arrays, and nested arrays are invalid text values. Empty strings/arrays are valid and emit no tokens. Array values are analyzed separately; their positions and offsets never share a coordinate space.

Changes must be atomic and incrementally maintain native index state. A caller must know what a completed operation observed or committed, whether cancellation rolled a change back, and when an external transport failure leaves the outcome unknown.

The implementation must not read/re-tokenize unrelated original records, regenerate every posting list, or rebuild the entire dictionary as its routine replace/remove strategy. It may copy affected shared buckets and traverse affected common-term data. Quantify that work rather than claiming constant-time mutation.
